biggest_catch: The offer EXPIRES SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 — 8 days from verification — and it requires 3 straight months of $1,000+/month deposits plus 10 transactions/month. Missing any single month voids the bonus.
catches: Offer window: apply 7/20/2026–9/30/2026 — the deadline is days away; re-verify the offer still exists before recommending.
Three consecutive statement cycles each require: $1,000+ in qualifying deposits per month, 10+ transactions per month, paperless-statement enrollment, and no monthly service fee incurred.
Qualifying deposits are narrow: payroll/government income via ACH, RTP/FedNow, or eligible card-network credits. Transfers, mobile deposits, Zelle, branch deposits, and ATM deposits do NOT count.
10 monthly transactions must be signature/credit or debit card transactions — bill-pay/ACH debits don't count as card transactions.
MyRewards Checking carries a $10 monthly service fee if the monthly conditions fail — failing the conditions both loses the bonus and triggers fees.
Membership eligibility is limited — Rogue operates in Oregon, California, and Idaho; confirm the user is eligible before they apply.
One $500 bonus per member and per account; business accounts and members under 18 are excluded; existing MyRewards checking holders may be excluded.

steps: Confirm you are eligible for Rogue Credit Union membership (Oregon, California, Idaho service areas) at https://www.roguecu.org/personal-services/personal-deposit-accounts/checking/myrewards-checking/welcome-bonus-plus.
Apply for a new MyRewards Checking account NO LATER than September 30, 2026 — this is a hard deadline.

For each of the next 3 consecutive statement cycles: receive at least $1,000 in qualifying deposits per month (payroll/government income via ACH, RTP/FedNow, or card-network credits — not Zelle, transfers, or mobile deposits).
In the same 3 statement cycles: make at least 10 debit/credit card transactions per month.
Stay enrolled in paperless statements for all 3 cycles and avoid incurring the $10 monthly service fee.
After the third qualifying cycle, the $500 bonus is deposited within 30 calendar days — keep the account open until it lands.
